Theme

Latin word

pāx

pāx, pācis f.

noun, third declension

peace; peace and order: public security

In this lexicon

  • peace

    the recommended word · classical · Liv. 30.30.19; Cic. Phil. 2.113; Traupman 187

  • security

    also used · classical · Suet. Tib. 37.1: tuendae pācis ā grassātūrīs ac latrōciniīs; M-O s.v. public safety or security
